title: Gods of Olympus
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1 is Gods of Olympus catalogue artwork. Change ONLY framing of the foreground gauntlet and title group. Scale the complete golden-blue gauntlet (including its full wrist cuff and all five fingers), nearby lightning glow, and complete "Gods of Olympus" lettering/ornament uniformly to 75% of their current size and center their whole group in the same true 2:1 canvas. Seamlessly extend the existing marble terrace, cloud-palace, sky and clouds into the freed space. Preserve exact title wording, all five-finger glove anatomy, gold/cobalt/laurel details, title style, palette, lighting and illustration quality. Every letter and the whole gauntlet must fit within central 80% width / 70% height, at least 15% below top and above bottom. Do not add or remove objects, religious figures, other words, UI, logos, slogans or watermark. One opaque image only.
initialGenerationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original premium illustrated slot-game catalogue title card.
Primary request: one beautiful finished Gods of Olympus key-art card based on its established cloud-palace and Zeus-gauntlet theme.
Scene/backdrop: a white-marble and gold Olympian terrace above soft clouds, distant classical Greek palace, indigo-blue sky, a few restrained electric-blue lightning arcs and hints of purple drapery at the outer edges. Airy depth, not clutter.
Subject: an ornate golden armoured gauntlet with deep cobalt-blue enamel panels and small gold laurel motifs, posed reaching forward as a magical collector artifact, lit by restrained blue lightning. Clean readable five-finger glove anatomy, no human body or face. Gauntlet is the sole main foreground subject, cloud-palace architecture stays atmospheric.
Style/medium: premium professionally painted fantasy game key art, polished illustrated gold/marble/enamel materials, controlled dramatic lighting and clear silhouette. Indigo, purple, warm ivory and gold with electric-blue accents; no excessive glow.
Composition/framing: TRUE wide 2:1 landscape. Dynamic gauntlet occupies the left side of the central composition while large title balances on the right, without overlap. Keep full title and the complete gauntlet comfortably inside x=15%–85%, y=20%–80%; use broad quiet cloud/sky margins around the compact focal group. All essential lettering/subject must fit central 80% width / 70% height. Readable at 256x128.
Text (verbatim): "Gods of Olympus". Exactly these three words once, two substantial lines: "Gods of" above "Olympus". Elegant monumental gold/ivory serif lettering with a subtle deep-indigo shadow for excellent contrast. The word "of" must remain readable.
Constraints: no added deities, other religious/cultural symbols or human portraits; use only established Greek cloud-palace, gauntlet, laurel and lightning motifs. No extra wording, slogans, payout claims, currency, reels, buttons, fake UI, logos, brands or watermark. Opaque background. One image only.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected master and 768x384 WebP. Complete title correct; gold/cobalt five-finger gauntlet, blue lightning, laurel details and white/gold cloud-palace preserve existing theme. No added deity portraits, unrelated cultural motifs or fake interface.
visualCheck.thumbnail: Inspected at 256x128. All title words including 'of' remain clear; gauntlet and lightning silhouette remain distinct against cloud architecture.
visualCheck.crop: Framing-only v2 puts title and whole gauntlet inside central 80% width / 70% height; architectural columns and drapery are background framing.
visualCheck.compression: WebP quality 84; 100,104 bytes, under 120 KB ideal target.
visualCheck.revision: Original master retained outside src; v2 selects the crop-safety refinement. Artwork files only.
